senses.gloss:
चैल चैल, अम्, n. = चेल, a piece of cloth,
clothes, a garment; (अस्), m. a moth; (अस्, ई, अम्),
cloth, made of cloth; bred in clothes (as insects,
lice, &c.).
—चैल-धाव, अस्, m. a washerman,
—चैलाशक (˚ल-आश्˚), अस्, m. a kind of goblin
feeding on moths and lice.

चैलक, अस्, m. a Buddhist mendicant having only
a piece of cloth round the middle of the body.
चैलिक, अस्, m. a piece of cloth.

चैलकि चैलकि, इस्, m. (fr. चेलक), a patro-
nymic of Jīvala.
चैलेय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. चेल), made of cloth.
